You are at Excellent; to stay there, keep every scenario measurable and add a brief note on why lower-ranked attributes were excluded." ~65 words. Good.

C2: "Your modular monolith recommendation in Q2 is clear and scenario-specific: five developers versus service overhead, and the known single-VM/20-minute downtime versus rewrite cost. You also acknowledge the downside (no independent scaling; one module can crash the process). Excellent level. To strengthen auditability, add an explicit assumptions subsection (independence, 30-day month, constant failure rates) alongside your calculations." ~60.
